}}'''Zorelle''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] who lived during the [[Age of Legends]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Zorelle}}

==History==
Zorelle Sedai is from [[M'Jinn]]. She had one of the [[Da'shain]] [[Aiel]] named [[Nalla]] in her service. When Nalla proposed to [[Charn]], he thinks of accepting, knowing he will have to change his service from [[Mierin]] to Zorelle.{{ref/book|4|26}}
